1 مَزَجَ , (S, K,) aor.
مَزُجَ , (L Msb,) [not
مَزَجَ , as in the lexicons of Golius and Freytag,] inf. n. مَزْجٌ, (K, &c.,) He mixed, mingled, incorporated, or blended, (S, K,) a thing with (بِ) water; (Msb;) or beverage, or wine, (شَرَاب,) with
something else. (S.) ―
-b2- مَزَجَ (tropical:) He exasperated, or irritated. (K.) مَزَجْتُهُ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ I enraged him, and exasperated him, or irritated him, against his companion. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
